info.description: INCOMPLETE contract (#82 PR3): Chat, Responses and Messages retain six schema placeholders for PR2. All other areas document their real HTTP and media contracts; zero placeholders is required once PR2 lands. Every operation authenticates with an inference key only (Bearer; /v1/messages also accepts x-api-key, GET /v1/realtime also the openai-insecure-api-key.<key> WebSocket subprotocol, never both); inference keys never authorize management and admin tokens never authorize inference. Live key, workspace, catalog and budget checks remain authoritative. The OpenAI-shaped, Anthropic-shaped, job and file error envelopes are distinct schemas and never the management ErrorEnvelope; /v1/messages errors carry no gateway machine code. x-omg-* extensions state what OpenAPI 3.1 cannot express (see docs/openapi/inference/README.md).

post.description: OpenAI-compatible subset (protocols/images.rs): base64 images only, never URLs. Unknown fields (output_format, background, style, user, ...) are refused with 400 invalid_request_error.

200.description: The generated images and observed usage

post.description: Incomplete: the request, the success and the SSE contracts arrive with the generation protocols. Documented already because they differ from every other route: errors are Anthropic-shaped with NO gateway machine code, and the outer transport layer rewrites 405 and 413 into the same shape on this path (http.rs request_context; protocols/messages.rs http_error). Authentication is Authorization: Bearer or x-api-key, never both.

401.description: Missing, malformed, duplicate, mixed or unknown credential

405.description: Another method on /v1/messages, after authentication: an Anthropic-shaped invalid_request_error 'Method not allowed' that keeps the Allow header (http.rs request_context). Not an operation of this path: only POST is served.

413.description: The body exceeds the shared 2 MiB cap, whether the body-limit layer or the handler refuses it: always request_too_large, never the OpenAI payload_too_large

get.description: Live-revalidated, catalog-eligible models of the key's workspace (http.rs models; catalog.rs key_models). Advisory: admission re-checks everything. No query parameter is read; unknown ones are ignored. A key invalidated since authentication is refused exactly like an unknown key.

200.description: The models, ordered by public name

get.summary: List the models this key may call now

get.description: OpenAI GA Realtime WebSocket. HTTP errors precede upgrade; errors after upgrade are events and closes, not HTTP responses. Declared Content-Length above the fixed 2 MiB root limit is refused with plain text 413, including GET.

101.description: WebSocket upgrade, after live authentication, admission and upstream connection. Sec-WebSocket-Protocol is realtime only when offered; credentials are never reflected.

x-omg-refusals.trigger: Missing, invalid, ambiguous credentials or x-api-key
Realtime beta header or unsupported subprotocol
Invalid model query, unknown query parameter or missing WebSocket upgrade

x-omg-websocket.description: GA only; beta realtime header, unknown subprotocols and unknown/duplicate model query parameters are refused. Frames are validated by a strict event allowlist, never modeled as HTTP bodies. Unknown events produce an error, not a silent drop. Frame payloads and limits are specified in docs/realtime.md.
